content:
The test image shows a corn plant with prominent dark purple/brown lesions on the stalk and leaf sheaths/collars, along with dead/dried leaves and some leaf spotting on green leaves. The primary affected parts are stem and leaf.

Top stem candidates: Anthracnose_Leaf_Spot_And_Top_Dieback, Purple_Leaf_Sheath, Physoderma_Brown_Spot. Let me check references one at a time.
Anthracnose stem shows black lesions on stalk rind with internal rot. The test image has more diffuse purple-brown coloring at leaf sheaths. Let me check Purple_Leaf_Sheath.
Purple Leaf Sheath shows dark brown/purple lesions on the leaf sheath, similar to the test image. Let me check Physoderma_Brown_Spot.
Physoderma shows small yellowish-brown spots in bands on leaves with dark spots on midrib. The test image leaves do show some spotting. Let me check Goss_S_Wilt.
Goss's Wilt shows large water-soaked lesions with wavy edges - doesn't match the test image pattern. Let me check Northern_Leaf_Blight.
NLB shows cigar-shaped tan lesions - not matching the test image. Let me check Anthracnose leaf and Tar_Spot.
Tar Spot shows distinct black raised spots. The test image spots are different. Let me use my last view to confirm Purple_Leaf_Sheath with another reference.

Both Purple_Leaf_Sheath references show dark brown/purple lesions on the leaf sheath area of the stalk, which closely matches the test image. The test image shows:

1. **Dark purple-brown discoloration on the leaf sheaths** wrapping around the stalk at multiple nodes - the most prominent feature
2. Dead/dried leaves
3. Some spotting on remaining green leaves

The Purple_Leaf_Sheath references show the same type of dark lesions at the leaf collar/sheath area. The KB description confirms: "Dark lesions on corn stalks and leaf collars, with color varying from purple to brown to black." This is the closest visual match among all candidates viewed.
